title: Lint Fix Summary
description: Output of `nanoif lint --fix FILE... --summary-out PATH` (ADR-025): what the formatting fixer changed in each file it was given. Written only when every file was fixed and written.

files.description: Every file given, in the order given

file.description: The path as given on the command line

fixed.description: Issues fixed per rule; empty when the file needed nothing

total.description: Sum of every count in files[].fixed
